initial.title: [v0.92.1][runtime][observatory] Make Polis name and domain config-owned and visible
initial.goal: Produce one validated Runtime-owned Polis identity projection rendered by the HTML Observatory.
initial.required_outcome: Runtime configuration, feed projection, atomic last-known-good hot reload of every Polis parameter, and HTML rendering pass without restarting the Runtime or reactivating Unity.
authority_boundary: Unity issue #84 is backlog and non-gating
DNS TLS routing certificates and continuity-state mutation are outside authority
operator_constraints: Never write tracked issue work on main
No external infrastructure or credential mutation
initial.task_boundary: Exactly one Runtime-owned Polis identity projection and HTML consumer; Unity remains deferred.
deliverables: Validated Runtime init Polis identity contract
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Startup rejects missing duplicated malformed or endpoint-inconsistent identity
AC-2: Feed v3 exposes exact redacted configured identity and public endpoints while legacy v1 and v2 remain explicit compatibility-only contracts
AC-3: HTML renders feed values without URL inference or deployment constants
AC-4: Every Polis parameter hot-loads atomically without Runtime restart, while invalid edits retain the complete last-known-good snapshot with a bounded redacted diagnostic
AC-5: Exact nonzero tests formatting diff hygiene and exact-head review pass
non_goals: DNS TLS certificate or ingress mutation
initial.plan_summary: Add the required validated Polis init contract, project it through the Runtime feed, atomically hot-load every Polis parameter without restart, update HTML rendering, and retain focused review evidence.

steps.action: Implement and test the validated Runtime Polis identity configuration contract.
Project the redacted identity through the Observatory feed and production startup/reload path.
Replace HTML deployment constants with feed-owned rendering and focused tests.
Run focused proof and obtain independent exact-head review before publication.

invariants: Every Polis parameter may hot-load without restarting the Runtime
A reload publishes one complete validated snapshot or no change
Invalid reloads preserve the complete last-known-good snapshot
Identity projection and diagnostics remain redacted
risks: A partial reload exposes mixed old and new Polis values
Runtime and HTML consumers do not converge on the newly loaded snapshot
HTML retains a hidden deployment fallback
stop_conditions: A reload requires Runtime restart or exposes mixed Polis values

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove valid duplicate invalid mismatch diagnostics and reload-retention configuration behavior with a nonzero target.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: The named polis_identity cases are #551 implementation deliverables.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove exact redacted v3 projection reload diagnostics and explicit v1 v2 compatibility with nonzero targets.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: The issue-owned wrapper and named control Observatory and OpenAPI cases are #551 implementation deliverables.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Run the exact Node file and reject a zero-test TAP result while proving feed-owned HTML rendering.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: The issue-owned wrapper and Node test file are #551 implementation deliverables.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove Rust formatting for the exact workspace.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on scope drift, Unity activation, identity ambiguity, secret exposure, zero-test proof, or stale review.
review_prompts: Does a reload atomically replace every Polis parameter without Runtime restart?
Do invalid reloads preserve the complete last-known-good snapshot?
Does HTML use only the feed identity?
Is Unity absent from the diff?
initial.review_scope: Exact #551 Runtime configuration, feed, reload, HTML, tests, evidence, and lifecycle paths only.
